name: Egg-Wrapped Breakfast Bagel
desc: Bagel halves pressed into beaten eggs in the pan, flipped, filled and folded into a sandwich.

source.title: Egg-Wrapped Breakfast Bagel
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

steps: Beat the eggs with the salt and pepper.
Melt the butter in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Pour in the eggs and tilt the pan so they spread into an even layer.
Right away, press both bagel halves cut side down into the egg.
Cook until the egg is set, about 3 to 4 minutes, then flip the whole thing over with a wide spatula.
Fold the egg edges in over the bagel halves. Lay the cheese and avocado on one half and close the sandwich with the other. Cook 1 minute more to melt the cheese.
